column1: # The caravan (scripts/caravan_interior.gd): its door and step, the things in it to play with. id, seconds, destination, prompt.

column4: A camping caravan's thin aluminium door unlatched and swung open: a cheap chrome latch clicks, the light door rattles on its hinges, close, no music.
A camping caravan's thin door pulled shut: a hollow tinny slam, the latch snapping home, the whole van shudders a little, close, no music.
Stepping up onto a caravan's folding metal step: a squeak and a clank, the van's springs creaking under the weight, close, no music.
A small caravan fridge door pulled open: the rubber seal unsticking with a soft suck, bottles clinking inside, close, no music.
A small fridge door pushed shut: a dull padded thud, bottles clinking inside, close, no music.
The steady low hum and quiet gurgle of an old gas absorption fridge in a small quiet caravan, close, loopable, no music.
The igniter of a little gas cooker clicking three times, then a gas ring catching with a soft whump, close, no music.
A gas ring burning on a small camping stove, a steady soft hiss and quiet roar, close, loopable, no music.
A small stovetop kettle coming to the boil: rumbling and ticking water, then a rising shrill whistle that keeps going, close, no music.
A caravan's little tap turned on: the electric water pump buzzing and water splashing into a small steel sink, then turned off, close, no music.
An old black-and-white portable television switched on: a high whine, crackling static hiss, then a steady test-card tone, close, no music.
An old portable television switched off: a click and a short fading electric whine, close, no music.
A small gas heater being lit: the igniter clicking, a soft pop, then the hiss of the burner catching, close, no music.
A small gas heater burning steadily, a soft hiss with now and then the tick of warming metal, close, loopable, no music.
A sleepy fat ginger cat woken up, one short grumpy meow, close, indoors, no music.
A cat purring loudly and contentedly, very close, loopable, no music.
A heavy cat jumping down from a cushioned seat onto a vinyl floor with a soft thump, then trotting away, close, no music.
An old teddy bear's squeaker squeezed, a tired wheezy squeak, close, no music.
A plastic overhead locker in a caravan flipped open with a clack, then a box of playing cards and a small tin fall out onto a table with a clatter, close, no music.
A caravan's plastic overhead locker pushed shut with a clack and a rattle, close, no music.
Making up a caravan dinette into a bed: a table lowered with a metal clunk, cushions shuffled and slapped into place, a blanket shaken out with a whump, close, no music.
A plastic rocker light switch clicked and a small dome lamp buzzing on, close, no music.
A plastic roof vent hatch in a caravan cranked open: a squeaky winding handle, the hatch lifting, the birds and the wind outside suddenly clearer, close, no music.
An old transistor radio switched on: a click, crackling static and a tuning whistle sweeping across stations, close, no music.
